skill_name: Come up with an effective exercise routine.
workflow: A good exercise routine should include a variety of different types of exercise, such as aerobic, strength, and stretching. It should also include both low and high-intensity workouts. It is important to vary the exercises and incorporate different movements. This will help to work the various muscles in the body and induce a greater range of motion.
